briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate multi-agent race as compute bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases amid regulatory scrutiny, with total quarterly funding surpassing $11B. Multi-agent systems dominate development focus while safety gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced tool use; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-R2 matches GPT-5 performance at lower cost; xAI's Grok-3 and Meta's Llama 4.1 compete in open weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with new exploits reported in automotive CAN bus agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Google and Microsoft expand TPU and custom ASIC clusters; energy constraints delay two major US data center projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Which lab will first demonstrate reliable 100-agent coordination without human oversight?
